text.en:
The following items of appropriation under section one, subsection A, paragraph (a), of
Commonwealth Act Numbered Five hundred and sixty-six are amended so as to read as follows:
(See Table of COMMONWEALTH ACT No. 612 in COMMONWEALTH ACTS 513-653, 1940-1941 Page

The following items of appropriations are inserted in section one, subsection A, paragraph (a), of
Commonwealth Act Numbered Five hundred and sixty-six:

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 29, 1940, with the exception of the following items: Section 1: Antique, items 11, lla, lib,
and lie; Leyte, items 21a and 21b.
